title: 1. The Novice Student (Cold Start)
description: A student encountering their first question on the intelligent tutoring platform. With zero previous interactions, all personal history features shrink gracefully to the training-pool global prior.
student_story: Brand new student to the platform attempting an average difficulty algebra question for the first time.

title: 2. Consistent High Performer
description: A diligent student with substantial platform practice (60 prior questions, 88% overall success) facing a familiar skill where they have consistently performed well.
student_story: Advanced student with strong track record encountering a standard equation solving problem.

title: 3. Strong Student, Weak Skill
description: A student who excels across general mathematics (78% overall accuracy) but has repeatedly struggled on this specific target skill (only 1 out of 8 correct).
student_story: Demonstrates that domain-specific skill history (the top-ranked feature) overrides broad overall competence when predicting struggle.

title: 4. Learner Improving with Practice
description: A student who struggled during early practice but has shown strong improvement over 30 questions, now demonstrating 75% accuracy on recent topic items.
student_story: Illustrates the role of Bayesian shrinkage as observation count grows and the student overcomes an initial cold start.

title: 5. Near-Threshold Decision Boundary
description: A borderline interaction situated precisely near the operational risk threshold (tau = 0.2880), illustrating how the classification decision handles uncertainty.
student_story: A student with moderate history attempting an above-average difficulty question, balancing right on the edge of the intervention trigger.
